Maria G.: Quick heads-up — the grant-suggestions modal is spamming per-route recommendations for Tenant X (they have ~220 routes). UX looks noisy and our suggestions API is spiking.
Kevin: can you paste a screenshot or repro steps?
Maria G.: Sure — clicking "Suggest grants" on a tenant with many routes returns a line for each route with the same underlying permission. huge list.
Samir: FYI telemetry shows suggestions_service_requests spiked 3x and errors from permission-graph API: 
```
HTTP 429 POST /v1/permissions/suggest  -> 429 Too Many Requests
{"tenant_id":"t-123","routes_examined":218}
```
Lee: Oof. Sounds like we should collapse identical suggestions into a pattern after the backend groups by capability+resource-pattern.
Jen (Console): From the UX side — we should surface "Apply to all matching routes (n=218)" with a preview + toggle, rather than listing 200 lines. Also show why the suggestion exists and a confidence score.
Kevin: Agree. What's the backend cost to group first? Samir: Grouping reduces duplicate graph traversals a lot. Current impl calls permission checks per-route. Instead we can compute capability -> set(routes) in one pass then emit suggestions per capability. That knocks calls down from O(N) to O(1) graph walk + set ops.
rbac-bot: alert: suggest-service latency increase detected (p95 2.1s -> 4.8s) for tenant t-123, raising incident flag.
Maria G.: Good to know. Also we should consider a threshold: if routes > 50, collapse by default and show an expandable list. Prevents modal freeze.
Samir: Practically: add an arg on the suggest API: `group_by_pattern=true|false`, default true for large tenants. Also add telemetry tags: `suggestions.grouped=true`.
Lee: UX note: when collapsed, show sample routes (up to 5) and an "expand all" link. Also add inline search so admin can filter by route name.
Jen (Console): I'll sketch a mock: show badge "218 matching routes" next to the suggestion, and a small help tooltip explaining grouping rules. We should also expose an advanced link: "View exact route list (CSV)" for audits.
Samir: Implementation concerns: permission-graph does not currently return route patterns. We'll need a lightweight canonicalizer for route names (strip tenant prefix, normalize param segments) so grouping is accurate. That might be a small infra + tests task.
Kevin: We should gate rollout: enable grouped suggestions for 10% of tenants first, measure dropped errors and UX clicks. Add a canary flag `console.suggest_grouped_canary`.
Maria G.: Agreed. Metrics to track: suggestions_per_min, suggestions_grouped_ratio, suggestion_clickthrough_rate, api_429_rate, avg_latency.
rbac-bot: note: scheduled deploy of suggest-service v2 at 2024-11-12T03:00Z (canary).
Lee: One more: quota interplay — when grouping we reduce API calls and therefore reduce tenant-level quota burn. Good ops outcome. Need to update docs + quota dashboard.
Samir: I'll add the backend PR: 1) grouping pass, 2) api param, 3) metrics tags.
Jen (Console): I'll attach a mock and copy for tooltip in the UX repo.
Kevin: Let's create a small playbook for anomalies: if grouped suggestions drop confidence below 0.6, surface an inline warning and fall back to per-route listing for that capability.
Maria G.: Nice. Action items: Samir (backend PR + canary flag), Jen (mock + tooltip), Lee (audit CSV endpoint), Kevin (run canary and dashboard alerts). I'll follow up with a brief spec in the RFC thread. :thumbsup:
Kevin: ack.
Samir: starting on the backend today, will ping when I have a draft.
Jen (Console): mock uploaded to Figma link: https://figma.com/s/tenant-suggest-mock (preview).
rbac-bot: resolved: temporary incident cleared after traffic reroute; 429s reduced post-throttle at 1789900300.
